properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured), RECURRENCE: add_decision's loop hint still says "a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it" on a write that landed ACCEPTED. The string is fixed text (capture.rs), so it is wrong on every add_decision whose `status` is past proposed. The 2026-08-14 defect named the merge path and the fix shape. On 2026-09-06 the one-call status+approver path multiplied the wrong case, and the fix was never made
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I2 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (flo2 design 50f966697d6c5024, reflow2 0.74.0 behind the claude.ai connector). add_decision(id: dec:claude-makes-every-design-decision-by-delegation, kind: choice, status: accepted) replied with properties.status "accepted" AND loop_hint "loop: a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)". The designer read that as the gate contradicting itself. NOT affected: add_decision that lands proposed, where the hint is true.

② PRECEDENT: fact:defect-add-decision-hints-lands-proposed-on-a-write-that-left-it-accepted (2026-08-14, Alex's Grok session). It is the same string, reported on the MERGE path (an existing accepted node revised). Its fix shape: "emit the hint only when the write created a proposed node, or state the status the node now holds". Still unfixed 46 days later.

③ CANDIDATES.
(a) The hint is a constant, not computed from the result.
(b) The gateway rewrote the status after reflow2 answered.
(c) The observation is wrong: the node did not land accepted.

④⑤ MEASURED 2026-09-29.
· crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs around line 2966: with_capture_notes(node, "loop: a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)", …). It is a literal, with no branch on node.status. So (a) is confirmed.
· The reply's own properties.status read "accepted", with flo2's note "The approval was recorded as the signed-in person's own", so the node did land accepted. (c) is refuted.
· flo2's bindApprovals fills the approver and leaves `status` untouched (measured the same day). (b) is refuted.

⑥ CLASS: a reply sentence hand-written for the common case and never conditioned on the result it describes. The August report fixed nothing. When chg:the-owners-word-rides-the-same-call-as-the-status-it-signs (2026-09-06) let constructors take status+approver, it made the wrong case the NORMAL shape of a one-call settle. The skill-side twin was fixed on 2026-08-08 by checking the returned status, and the tool's own text was not given the same treatment. Fixing the merge path alone would not have stopped this report.

⑦⑧ OWED. Pin it with a test: add_decision with status accepted plus an approver must return no hint claiming proposed, and a merge over an accepted node likewise. Then derive the hint from node.status.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED. Whether other constructors' capture notes carry the same fixed-text shape (add_requirement, add_design_rule): not swept.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #623 (squash 449ba2b). Its change record, chg:a-loop-hint-says-where-the-node-landed, is in the committed design (main's export), not in this live store.

Verified in the merged code:
- add_decision's hint is computed by decision_landing_hint() from the status the node landed at, not from a literal.
- The same fixed-sentence shape was fixed in add_design_rule and add_capability.
- It is pinned by crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_loop_hint_says_where_the_node_landed.rs (4 of 5 observed failing first).
